brief: The 6-tool indie dev stack — from idea to deploy in a weekend.

slots.tagline: Notion turns scattered thoughts into structured roadmaps before a single line of code.
slots.f1Body: Centralize requirements, user stories, and project scope in one living document.
slots.f2Body: Track tasks across backlog, doing, and done with drag-and-drop simplicity.
slots.f3Body: Generate outlines, summaries, and action items to accelerate planning.

slots.tagline: Figma lets you prototype pixel-perfect interfaces and handoff assets in real time.
slots.f1Body: Build responsive components that adapt to content without manual resizing.
slots.f2Body: Inspect CSS, copy assets, and bridge design-to-code with one shared link.
slots.f3Body: Click through flows and test UX before writing a single React component.

slots.tagline: Cursor is the AI-first editor that turns natural language into production-ready features.
slots.f1Body: Accept multi-line suggestions that understand your entire codebase context.
slots.f2Body: Ask questions, refactor files, and debug errors without leaving the editor.
slots.f3Body: Generate components, tests, and API routes from a single prompt.

slots.tagline: Supabase delivers Postgres, auth, and real-time APIs without backend boilerplate.
slots.f1Body: Store relational data with full SQL power and zero server management.
slots.f2Body: Add magic links, OAuth, and row-level security in minutes, not days.
slots.f3Body: Run serverless TypeScript close to users for low-latency API responses.

slots.tagline: GitHub stores code, runs CI, and manages releases for every indie project.
slots.f1Body: Branch, merge, and review changes with pull requests and protected branches.
slots.f2Body: Automate tests, linting, and deployments on every push to main.
slots.f3Body: Track bugs and features with kanban boards tied directly to your codebase.

slots.tagline: Vercel ships Next.js to a global edge network with instant previews and scale.
slots.f1Body: Get a unique URL for every pull request to share progress before merging.
slots.f2Body: Monitor Core Web Vitals and traffic with built-in real-time dashboards.
slots.f3Body: Run API routes and middleware at the edge without provisioning servers.

slots.ctaBody: Steal this 6-tool workflow and go from idea to live app in 48 hours. No backend team required.
